prerequisites: Open / and /judge; read hero, 4-authority diagram, claims/limits; compare with the pedagogy and tooling landscape
steps: 1. Read home hero and sidebar copy
2. Read /judge dossier (hero, authorities, modes, limits)

3. Search either page for: (a) any acknowledgment of Predict-Observe-Explain / Peer Instruction lineage, (b) any one-sentence invariant of the form 'no number here was written by an AI', (c) any explicit contrast vs chat tutors / Kaggle lesson / leakage linters
4. Compare findings to prior art: POE (White & Gunstone 1992), Peer Instruction (Mazur 1997), LAMS POE confidence step, sklearn-diagnose, NBLyzer, OpenAI Evals, zkML verifiable evals
expected: A judge can repeat the product's distinctive claim verbatim after 20 seconds: e.g. 'Commitment pedagogy (POE/Mazur), but the reveal is computed by a pinned kernel from your notebook, your prediction is sealed first, and the belief change ships as a checkable signed artifact.'
actual: Strong tagline exists ('Ask like chat. Prove it like science.') and /judge has 'Generated vs. computed vs. verified', but nowhere is the delta stated in one sentence, no lineage is cited, and no named contrast is made. A judge with education background sees Mazur 1997; a technical judge sees a leakage linter with chat; the distinctive composition (sealed prediction + fixed-kernel computed evidence + frozen verifier + signed artifact + transfer-gated repair on the learner's own notebook) must be self-assembled.

title: 'Proof Capsule' is self-signed HMAC with no independent verification path; 'proof' overclaims vs verifiable-computation prior art
reproducibility: stable artifact inspection by Agent 1 (downloaded 34 KB record); cryptographic independence unverifiable from public surface

prerequisites: Complete a sample session; download proof record; look for public verifier spec/endpoint/key provenance
steps: 1. Inspect downloaded proof record (12 hash-chained events, integrity hmac-sha256, externalVerifier.status VERIFIED)
2. Search public surfaces for: verifier software id/hash, public verification endpoint, key management statement, reproduce script outputs

expected: Either 'proof' is independently checkable (public verifier spec/endpoint/reproduce script a third party can run and match), or the surface uses a calibrated word ('signed record', 'attested trace')
